notes.title: The Fridge is Red new updates!
notes.content:
Hell👁 evil appliance aficionados!

We appreciate all the feedback and reviews we've received. Thanks to them, we have updated the game by fixing bugs and incorporating some of your gameplay suggestions. 

We have already fixed a few bugs and improved the performance and navigation hints on some of the most challenging levels, like Charleen Mufi and Seaside.
You can find more details in the v1.0.8 patch notes.

Right now, we're working to make the Goldi Vern episode with the highway more linear, which will make it easier to go in the right direction and shorten the driving part at the same time. 

We are also going to introduce automated saving checkpoints to make the experience more enjoyable. 

In addition, we’ll be introducing a new mechanic to the hospital episode (Seaside), which you will have to discover for yourself! 

Last but not least, we have introduced Steam Trading cards for the game!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39686693/17e1c4eaa64c3150097ebfded57a43f7b28e3833.png

Thanks again for your feedback, reviews and support. We encourage you to play again once the upcoming changes are live and tell us what you think on Steam Reviews!

Don't hesitate to join our community on Discord to share your experience directly with the Development Team.

notes.title: The Fridge is Red has been unleashed!
notes.content:
Greetings, horror fans and evil appliance aficionados!

Celebrate The Fridge is Red release with us! 
Are you prepared to find out what’s inside?

[previewyoutube=IoDT-8p1D4I;full][/previewyoutube]

Get ready for six creepy tales.
Staring contest with the fridge monster. An Infinite maze of hospital hallways and archive backrooms. A haunted road trip along a frozen remote highway. A dreadful funeral ceremony, and a cursed elevator descending to the uncanny depths of the unknown.

Experience many more liminal spaces, surreal encounters and uncanny strangers in the full game. See you inside!

Huge thanks to everyone who played the early versions and the demo. We keep updating the game based on your feedback, which helps a lot.
Join our community on Discord to share your experience directly with the development team.

notes.title: The 5WORD Team celebrates three years of Death Crown!
notes.content:
Greetings, The Fridge is Red seekers and evil appliances' friends!

Today, we are happy to share with you that the studio behind The Fridge is Red, the 5WORD Team, is celebrating three years of their first game, also available on Steam: Death Crown.

Death Crown is a minimalist real time strategy game in a 1bit style, where you play Death herself, commanding her legions of death, and punishing humanity's Kingdom for its overconfidence.

[previewyoutube=TlNdSKNvJwY;full][/previewyoutube]

The 5WORD Team is also running a limited edition Death Crown t-shirt sale over here  to commemorate this milestone!

Join us in this celebration and congratulate the dev team in the comments here or on social media!

notes.title: 📢 New trailer & demo: The Fridge is Red rebrands its name and joins tinyBuild!
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1532460/

Today, we're incredibly thrilled to share that the game formerly known as Do Not Take Your Eyes Away From the Red Fridge joins the tinyBuild family as The Fridge is Red.

Watch the Announcement Trailer
[previewyoutube=Qcp2-a5gxzM;full][/previewyoutube]

The Fridge is Red is a first-person psychological horror game with different unsettling liminal spaces and surreal events inspired by analogue horror of the PSX era; among which you will face a mysterious household fridge that will chill the hell out of you - and your groceries!

Open your mind to a fridge of chilling, terrifying scenarios...

https://i.imgur.com/wCg4un6.gif

You can find the weirdest looking food within the Red Fridge... perhaps what you find is not food at all... are you brave enough to try it?

https://i.imgur.com/EKLyNPR.gif

Look around wisely to find clues and solve mysteries to survive different challenges.

https://i.imgur.com/WhsnX5N.gif

Check your surroundings, investigate, and do not take your eyes away from the red fridge!

Play the demo and share your feedback in the comments below or on our official The Fridge is Red Discord server to keep in touch with other players and the developers! 
Make sure to subscribe to our newsletter and to follow our social media to stay up to date with all the important updates!
